subject.title: fix(memory): increase QMD embedTimeoutMs default to 600s for local GG…

question: Should unset QMD `embedTimeoutMs` move from 120s to 600s for all existing QMD users, or should the fix be narrower or explicit?
rationale: The code change is small, but source inspection shows it changes upgrade behavior and lock contention budgets for every existing unset QMD config, which is a maintainer default-policy choice.

options.title: Require proof or override first
options.body: Keep this PR blocked until redacted real QMD/GGUF embed proof is supplied or a maintainer explicitly accepts the broad default and lock-budget tradeoff.

options.title: Narrow the strategy
options.body: Ask for a selective local-GGUF/default-detection path or warning/docs-only change so existing unset configs do not all inherit the longer timeout.

options.title: Accept the broad default
options.body: Merge after maintainer review if maintainers intentionally want all unset QMD semantic users to inherit longer embed and lock waits.

recommendation.title: Require proof or override first
recommendation.body: Keep this PR blocked until redacted real QMD/GGUF embed proof is supplied or a maintainer explicitly accepts the broad default and lock-budget tradeoff.
